stdout: (no config - demo: three FICTIONAL candidates for a FICTIONAL seed-stage first marketer role at Example Co.; every weight and rating is an example input, not a benchmark)
ROLE - First marketer (Example Co., fictional) (Seed); channel focus: community and LinkedIn content for finance leaders
By month 1: Ten customer conversations written up; tracking and website audited
By month 3: Tracking fixed, lead stages agreed with sales, three community experiments run
By month 6: The community channel producing qualified leads at the target agreed on day one, reported weekly
Competencies (weight, bar):
[must] Grows the working channel (community and LinkedIn content) - 30%, bar 3
[must] Understands the finance buyer - 20%, bar 3
[must] Plans tests with a measurable pass mark - 15%, bar 3
[must] Works hands-on without a team - 10%, bar 3
Runs email, website updates and basic tracking - 10%
Prioritises and states trade-offs honestly - 10%
Bonus skill: paid search - 5%
Hire line: weighted 3.00 on a 1-4 scale.
Stage: At seed the usual first hire is a hands-on generalist with one deep skill, with senior guidance from a founder or a fractional leader.
1. Candidate A (fictional) - HIRE - weighted 3.10 (with unevidenced ratings: 3.10); evidence covers 100% of the weight
[must] Grows the working channel (community and LinkedIn content): 3.5  (CEO 3, Practitioner 4)
[must] Understands the finance buyer: 3  (CEO 3, Account executive 3)
[must] Plans tests with a measurable pass mark: 3  (Practitioner 3)
[must] Works hands-on without a team: 3  (CEO 3)
Runs email, website updates and basic tracking: 3  (Practitioner 3)
Prioritises and states trade-offs honestly: 3  (CEO 3)
Bonus skill: paid search: 2  (Practitioner 2)
- Every must-have is at or above its bar, with evidence, and the weighted score 3.10 clears the hire line of 3.00.
> Check references on the deep skill: did they grow a channel, or run one someone else built?
2. Candidate B (fictional) - MORE-EVIDENCE - weighted 3.00 (with unevidenced ratings: 3.00); evidence covers 90% of the weight
[must] Grows the working channel (community and LinkedIn content): 3 SPLIT 2  (CEO 4, Practitioner 2)
[must] Understands the finance buyer: 3  (CEO 3)
[must] Plans tests with a measurable pass mark: 3  (Practitioner 3)
[must] Works hands-on without a team: 3  (CEO 3)
Runs email, website updates and basic tracking: no evidenced rating  (Account executive 3*)
Prioritises and states trade-offs honestly: 3  (CEO 3)
Bonus skill: paid search: 3  (Practitioner 3)
- Interviewers disagree on must-have "Grows the working channel (community and LinkedIn content)": Practitioner 2.00, CEO 4.00.
> Put Practitioner and CEO in one room with their notes on "Grows the working channel (community and LinkedIn content)" before anyone decides. Settle it on the evidence, not on who argues best.
> Ask Account executive for the example behind their 3 on "Runs email, website updates and basic tracking", or drop the rating. It is not in the score until it has one.
> The note behind CEO's 3 on "Prioritises and states trade-offs honestly" ("Good") is an opinion, not an example. Ask what the candidate said or did.
3. Candidate C (fictional) - NO-HIRE - weighted 2.89 (with unevidenced ratings: 2.89); evidence covers 95% of the weight
[must] Grows the working channel (community and LinkedIn content): 3  (CEO 3, Practitioner 3)
[must] Understands the finance buyer: 2 BELOW BAR 3  (CEO 2, Account executive 2)
[must] Plans tests with a measurable pass mark: 3  (Practitioner 3)
[must] Works hands-on without a team: 3  (CEO 3)
Runs email, website updates and basic tracking: 4  (Practitioner 4)
Prioritises and states trade-offs honestly: 3  (CEO 3)
Bonus skill: paid search: no evidenced rating
- Must-have "Understands the finance buyer" scores 2.00 against a bar of 3.00, and the panel agrees.

Candidate A (fictional) clears every bar with the highest weighted score (3.10). Candidate B (fictional) is still short of evidence; close that before you make the offer if you want a fair comparison.
(* = no evidence note; not counted in the score)
